title: Reference repeatability and transparent stereo export
hypothesis: For the explicitly specified unity route and PCM24 export, decoded output equals the imported stimulus at the same sample indices. This is a hypothesis to test, not an assumption about defaults.
configuration_required: Application executable digest, bundle version and build, verified running edition
OS version/build, hardware architecture and process execution architecture
Audio driver/device, device clock, sample rate, buffer, processing precision and ASIO-Guard
Project source and saved project hashes, sample start, musical/linear time base, tempo and meter
Track type, channel count/order, route, fader/pre-gain/pan law and balance, main output gain
Explicit absence/state of inserts, sends, channel strip, automation, normalization, dither, fades, crossfades, stretching and resampling
Ordinary Export Audio Mixdown path, exact selected output, offline/real-time mode, locator positions in samples, PCM24 WAV output
Preference snapshot or complete relevant settings record, plugin versions and dependencies
procedure: Generate and retain the deterministic stimulus corpus and its manifest with the local audio_probe tool.
Create a fresh project at 48000 Hz. Import one stereo stimulus without conversion at sample zero; explicitly establish the full configuration above.
Set the ordinary mixdown range to exactly [0, input frame count) in samples. Save the project and record the action trace.
Export three independently retained files under the same settings, including a project close/reopen and application restart across repeats. Record exact order and any observed changes.

Before accepting any export, record its actual decoded header: signed PCM24, 48000 Hz, two channels and 288000 frames. Validate channel layout separately: an absent mask, zero mask or FL/FR mask 3 is eligible only with a retained routing trace verifying stored left/right order. A conflicting or unknown declared layout cannot establish the required order. This format and layout check remains pending until target exports exist.
First compare reference repeats to one another. Report file-byte equality separately from decoded sample equality. Investigate mismatches before introducing tolerances.
Then compare each export to the source stimulus. Preserve signed outcomes even when they contradict the transparent-route hypothesis.
Only after reference behavior is measured, implement a bounded candidate from the behavioral specification and compare its output with reserved reference cases.

required_actual_channel_layout.unknown_or_conflicting_declared_layout: Cannot establish required channel order; do not accept E001.

initial_criteria.post_hoc_tolerance_changes: Require a new protocol revision with independent reference evidence; never tune against candidate failures.

interpretation: Comparator pass establishes only the numerical sample-comparison condition. Actual output format and channel layout require the separate recorded validation above; comparator pass alone is not E001 acceptance or evidence of input provenance.
Three repeats establish only observed repeatability for these cases, not a stochastic error distribution.
A mismatch can originate in configuration, instrument parsing, export semantics or target behavior; it is not automatically an audio-engine defect.
Matched output does not identify the internal algorithm uniquely.
Quick Audio Export is a separate experiment because its documented range and tail behavior differ from ordinary mixdown.
macOS 27 observations remain exploratory until reproduced on a supported OS.
